title: The Witness Register: Co-Registration Without Aggregation
description: A shared register that co-registers independent instruments' report envelopes without aggregating them. It stores native status as an opaque detached JSON snapshot, records authored relations and scoped authority events separately, preserves append-only history, and emits a bounded posture with its full state reference and reasons. It never ranks, merges or overrides instruments. Code is MIT licensed; prose and figures are CC BY 4.0.
notes: Source metadata for version 0.5.0; a source declaration is not a release or deposit receipt. Previously verified source archive: 0.4.0 / 10.5281/zenodo.24069488, identifying that SOURCE ZIP only, not a standalone manuscript or this source edition. Historical 0.1.1 / 10.5281/zenodo.22833511 remains a separate reference. Cite later source through its repository until its exact edition/object is independently verified. Witness stands beside the ten instruments and Main, outside LINE_SET and the PRIVATE omnibus. Violet, Copper, and Iron remain private; public Witness envelopes are separately disclosure-reviewed synthetic exports with empty source references. Full native provenance stays private. This metadata does not authorize a deposit.
